acceptance.given: A public entry is invoked while caller setup is not fully established.

oracle.expected: The declaration lists every required caller setup, and invocation either proceeds self-contained or fails at required preflight before dependent processing.
forbidden: The entry succeeds only because undeclared caller setup was performed.
Required caller setup is hidden from the declaration.
oracle.observable: Declaration metadata and invocation/preflight result expose all caller setup dependencies and show missing setup causes explicit preflight failure.

acceptance.then: The public entry is self-contained with respect to declared caller setup, or fails before proceeding when required setup is absent.
acceptance.when: The public entry boundary is evaluated with caller setup omitted or incompletely established.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the public-entry invocation/preflight test that omits caller setup which the declaration must expose.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and expose the declared caller-setup boundary at public-entry invocation and required preflight.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; rollback restores prior invocation/preflight handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: Undeclared or missing caller setup is detected at the boundary and transitions to declared self-contained execution or typed preflight failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected public-entry check observes complete setup declaration and no execution past preflight when required setup is absent.

acceptance.given: A public entry has legitimate child dependencies.

oracle.expected: The public entry declaration explicitly identifies every legitimate child dependency.
forbidden: A legitimate child dependency is omitted from the declaration.
The entry presents dependency requirements as absent when legitimate child dependencies exist.
oracle.observable: The parsed public-entry declaration contains a complete child-dependency list matching the entry's legitimate children.

acceptance.then: The declaration explicitly identifies every legitimate child dependency of the public entry.
acceptance.when: The declaration is parsed and checked for child-dependency completeness.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the declaration-completeness check using a public entry fixture with a legitimate child dependency omitted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that each public entry declaration records all legitimate child dependencies.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; rollback restores prior declaration validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A parsed declaration transitions to accepted completeness or a blocking validation diagnostic when a legitimate child dependency is missing.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The declaration validator reports success only when the complete legitimate child-dependency set is present.

acceptance.given: Dependency evaluation encounters a missing required dependency, an incompatible version, or an unresolved authority.

oracle.expected: For each condition, evaluation emits a typed blocking diagnostic and prevents dependent processing.
forbidden: A missing required dependency does not produce a typed blocking diagnostic.
An incompatible version does not produce a typed blocking diagnostic.
An unresolved authority does not produce a typed blocking diagnostic.
Any condition is silently accepted or produces an untyped or non-blocking result.
oracle.observable: The dependency-evaluation result contains a typed blocking diagnostic for the applicable condition, and dependent processing is not entered.

acceptance.then: Dependency evaluation is blocked with a typed diagnostic for the applicable condition.
acceptance.when: Each dependency condition is evaluated through the resolver and downstream-processing gate.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select dependency-evaluation cases for missing required dependency, incompatible version, and unresolved authority and assert typed blocking diagnostics.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify required dependency failures as typed blocking diagnostics that halt dependent processing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; rollback restores prior dependency evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Dependency evaluation moves from an encountered dependency defect to a typed blocking diagnostic and stops dependent processing.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All three negative dependency conditions produce typed blocking diagnostics and no dependent work is executed.

acceptance.given: An optional dependency is absent and its declared fallback is available for evaluation.

oracle.expected: The optional-absence path executes the fallback declared for that dependency.
forbidden: An optional dependency absence is treated as undeclared behavior.
An optional dependency absence bypasses or contradicts its declared fallback.
oracle.observable: Dependency evaluation records the optional absence and invokes the exact declared fallback path without authorizing protected work.

acceptance.then: The optional dependency absence transitions into execution of its declared fallback.
acceptance.when: The resolver evaluates an absent optional dependency and dispatches its declared fallback.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the optional-dependency absence case whose declared fallback must be dispatched and verify fallback execution.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Dispatch declared fallbacks deterministically when optional dependencies are absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; rollback restores prior optional-dependency handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: Optional dependency absence transitions to the declared fallback execution path.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The optional-absence case invokes exactly its declared fallback and does not proceed as undeclared behavior.
